query:
WITH wealth_percentages AS (
  SELECT 
    wealth_level,
    COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () as percentage
  FROM estishraf_llm_wealth_index
  GROUP BY wealth_level
),
cumulative_calc AS (
  SELECT 
    wealth_level,
    percentage,
    SUM(percentage) OVER (ORDER BY 
      CASE wealth_level 
        WHEN 'Rich' THEN 5
        WHEN 'Upper Middle' THEN 4
        WHEN 'Middle' THEN 3
        WHEN 'Lower Middle' THEN 2
        WHEN 'Poor' THEN 1
      END DESC
    ) as cumulative_pct
  FROM wealth_percentages
)
SELECT wealth_level, ROUND(percentage, 2) as percentage, ROUND(cumulative_pct, 2) as cumulative_pct
FROM cumulative_calc
WHERE cumulative_pct > 50
ORDER BY cumulative_pct DESC LIMIT 1200
